sloka: उपास्यहि रसान् भौमाम्स् तप्त्वा च जगद् अम्शुभिः ।परेत आचरिताम् भीमाम् रविर् आविशते दिशम् ॥२-६३-१५॥
transliteration: upāsyahi rasān bhaumāms taptvā ca jagad amśubhiḥ ।pareta ācaritām bhīmām ravir āviśate diśam ॥2-63-15॥

translations.english: Having sucked the waters of the earth and scorching the world with its rays, the Sun had entered the frightful southern quarter ranged by departed souls.
